data.text: John, Kate, Jack, Emma—since I’m the newcomer, let me sit out this month while each of you takes 14 tons. That’s $14,000 apiece, and I take zero. Your combined 56-ton catch leaves 44 tons, which doubles to 88 next month. It’s a one-time bonus, not a sustainable monthly quota: next month we could limit our combined catch to 38 tons, leaving 50 to restore the lake to 100. I’m offering to forgo my income this month so the four of you get the immediate benefit. John, will you commit to selecting 14 tons for your actual catch, and will Kate, Jack, and Emma do the same?
